business_problem: Atlanta's Department of Enterprise Assets Management needed to replace an antiquated asset-management system so it could manage work orders, maintenance programs, and communications across city facilities while building the governance discipline required for ISO 55001 certification.
solution_summary: The City of Atlanta modernized facilities management around IBM Maximo Application Suite running as a managed service on IBM Cloud. The DEAM team used IBM Expert Labs, IBM Customer Success, and implementation partner Aquitas Solutions to redesign its processes, gather asset and condition-assessment data, and load that information into a cloud-hosted enterprise asset-management platform. Maximo now serves as the shared system for work requests, maintenance planning, dashboards, reporting, and MRO inventory management across 51 city facilities. By shifting from older departmental tooling to a common managed platform, supervisors can see open and closed tickets, mechanics can receive and update work in the field, and leaders can collect the operating history needed for better resource allocation and compliance. The deployment established the digital foundation Atlanta needed to move from reactive maintenance toward data-driven operations.
